title: Swap primary/secondary styling on hero CTAs
description: In `src/pages/index.js`, change 'Get Started →' from `button button--lg homepage-primary-cta` to `button button--lg button--secondary`, and 'Find Your Path →' from `styles.secondaryCta` to `button button--lg homepage-primary-cta`.
